name: fibre-compare
description: Check which fibre and broadband deals are available at any UK postcode, with live speeds, prices and contract terms from fibrecompare.com.

interface.longDescription: Fibre Compare tells you exactly which broadband and full-fibre packages you can actually get at a UK address. Give it a postcode (or a UPRN for an exact premises) and it returns every available deal: provider, average download speed, monthly price in and out of contract, setup cost, contract length, key features and a direct sign-up link. Filter by minimum speed, maximum price, provider or contract length. Read-only: it never places orders.
